summary: {member} learns which question to take to a legislator if the board cannot change the qualification itself.
realLife: Mossberg offered to check whether the barrier to experienced out-of-state dispensers was statutory. Freeman observed that a change in statute would need a legislator to take it up. The state law booklet identifies an existing route for a license from a state the secretary finds to have at least equivalent requirements. When Freeman returned to broader reciprocity in June 2026, Mossberg said the change under discussion would need legislation.
inGame: needs: the legal source of the qualification and the board's delegated power.
